TotalAcceptedItemsAmount.name: Total Accepted Items Amount
TotalAcceptedItemsAmount.definition: Sum of the original total amounts of the invoices accepted for financing.

AppliedPercentage.name: Applied Percentage
AppliedPercentage.definition: Percentage rate applied to calculate the total amount financed related to the total amounts of the invoices accepted for financing. It represents the average percentage rate applied to all single invoice requests financed. It can be calculated as result of "TotalFinancedAmount" divided by "TotalAcceptedItemsAmount".

TotalFinancedAmount.name: Total Financed Amount
TotalFinancedAmount.definition: Total amount financed, defined as the entire financed amount of the requests.

FinancingDateDetails.name: Financing Date Details
FinancingDateDetails.definition: Set of dates (eg book date, credit date) related to the crediting of the financed amount.

CreditAccount.name: Credit Account
CreditAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account, held by Financing Requestor, actually used for crediting the amount financed.

FinancingAccount.name: Financing Account
FinancingAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the internal bank account actually used by First Agent to manage the line of credit granted to Financing Requestor.
